1.name: Aura of Vampirism
1.description: Envelop your party in a vampiric aura, granting them a chance to activate Vampirism on melee and ranged attacks. (L1) to 30 (L60) damage and healing. Vampirism : Leech the life force of your target, dealing 1 (L1) to 30 (L60) Corruption Damage and restoring Health by the same amount.

1.name: Locate Corpse
1.description: Link the soul of your target to its corporeal form, revealing the direction of their corpse in the current zone.

1.name: Polar Align: North
1.description: Face North - Magically align yourself, orienting you toward the North Pole.

1.name: Shadow Strike
1.description: Unleash a shadow strike upon your target, dealing 100% Weapon Ratio Damage plus 1 (L1) to 5 (L8) Corruption Damage and increasing your Threat against them by 20 (L1) to 200 (L60). Additionally, this ability extends the duration of any spell in the Swirling Shadows line on the target by 6 seconds.
1.valuesSummary: 100% weapon dmg · 1–5 Corruption dmg (L1–L8) · +20–200 Threat against them (L1–L60)

1.name: Taunt
1.description: Taunt your target, drawing their attention. This ability has additional effects in PvP. This ability is moderately difficult to resist.

1.name: Theft of Vigor
1.description: Thieve vigor from your target, decreasing their Strength and Stamina by 2 and increading yours by the same amount for 5 minutes.

2.name: Soulrend
2.description: Leeches the life force of your target, dealing 3 (L1) to 5 (L4) Corruption Damage and restoring your Health by the same amount. This spell is slightly difficult to resist.

2.name: Spirit Break
2.description: Breaks the spiritual defenses of your target, decreasing their Corruption, Holy, and Magic Resistance by 1 (L1) to 2 (L8) for 5 minutes. This spell cannot be resisted unless the target is immune to Magic effects.

3.name: Faltering Pulse
3.description: Terrify your target, disrupting their heartbeat for 24 seconds to lower their Agility by 2 and causing damage every 6 seconds that increases from 1 to 6.

3.name: Kick
3.description: Swiftly kick your target, interrupting their casting and preventing them from casting spells from the same school of magic for 4 seconds.

4.name: Goading Bash
4.description: Haughtily bash your target with your shield as you mock them, interrupting their spell casting and generating extra Threat against any target you block for the next 30 seconds.

5.name: Invisibility versus Undead
5.description: Shroud a target party member in darkness, rendering them unseen by undead for 10 minutes. This spell end immediately if you take damage.

5.name: Lull the Dead
5.description: Lull a target undead, reducing their Aggro Radius for 2 minutes. This spell has a very slight chance to end early.

6.name: Grip of Shadow
6.description: Reach into the shadows and grip your target, pulling them toward you, drawing their attention, and interrupting their casting.

7.name: Cold Protection
7.description: Ward your target against frost, increasing their Cold Resistance by 4 for 1 hour.

7.name: Focused Concentration
7.description: Greatly sharpen your concentration, granting you a 100% chance to continue casting through incoming melee attacks for 15 seconds.

7.name: Holy Protection
7.description: Wards your target against the divine, increasing their Holy Resistance by 5 for 35 minutes.

8.name: Grip of Agony
8.description: Causes enemy to writhe in a grip of agony, dealing 12 (L1) to 600 (L60) damage.

8.name: Life Draw
8.description: Draws your target's life force, dealing 9(L4) to 12(L8) damage and healing you for the same amount.

8.name: Lift Bones
8.description: Reanimates bones from the dead, creating a skeleton minion to serve you. This pet uses Strike. Persists until death of master. Requires Bone Chips.

9.name: Minor Spellshield
9.description: Encircle yourself with a magical shield, increasing your maximum Health by 10, Armor Calss by 5, and Magic Resistance by 5 for 1 hour.

10.name: Aura of the Unholy
10.description: An aura which increases your group's Attack Speed by 10% and Health Regeneration by 1 (L1) to 5 (L60).

10.name: Shadow Strike
10.description: Unleash a shadow strike upon your target, dealing 100% Weapon Ratio Damage plus 1 (L1) to 5 (L8) Corruption Damage and increasing your Threat against them by 20 (L1) to 200 (L60). Additionally, this ability extends the duration of any spell in the Swirling Shadows line on the target by 6 seconds.
10.valuesSummary: 100% weapon dmg · 1–5 Corruption dmg (L1–L8) · +20–200 Threat against them (L1–L60)

10.name: Swirling Shadows
10.description: Conjure swirling shadows that grip your target, dealing 3 Corruption Damage every 6 seconds and decreasing their Movement Speed by 30% for 24 seconds.

10.name: Terror in the Shadows
10.description: Cause nearby targets to cower in terror, stunning them for 10 seconds.

12.name: Feign Death (Spell)
12.description: Play dead, clearing all Threat from aggressive targets. This spell has a slight chance to fail. This spell has a chance to re-aggro targets when canceled.

13.name: Fear
13.description: Fears your enemy, causing them to run away in terror. Doing damage has a small chance to break this effect early.

14.name: Sacrifice Minion
14.description: Sacrifice your minion to create a barrier, absorbing 100 (L16) to 3000 (L60) Damage for 2 minutes.

15.name: Lesser Spellshield
15.description: Encircle yourself with a magical shield, increasing your maximum Health by 25, Armor Class by 10, and Magic Resistance by 10 for 1 hour.

16.name: Steal Strength
16.description: Steal power from your target, decreasing their Strength by 5 and increasing yours by the same amount for 5 minutes.

16.name: Repel The Dead
16.description: Wards an undead target with holy energy for 30 points of Holy Damage.

17.name: Deflect
17.description: Deflect magical attacks, reducing incoming Magic Damage dealt to you by 40% for 30 seconds.

20.name: Spirit Splinter
20.description: Splinter the spiritual defenses of your target, decreasing their Corruption, Holy, and Magic Resistance by 3 for 5 minutes.

22.name: Surging Shadows
22.description: Conjure surging shadows that grip your target, dealing 15 Corruption Damage every 6 seconds and decreasing their movement speed by 55% for 60 seconds.

24.name: Dark Embrace
24.description: Embrace your target with lingering shadows, restoring 40 Health and draining yours by the same amount.

28.name: Spellshield

28.name: Unholy Bulwark
28.description: Surround yourself with an unholy bulwark, granting you immunity to all incoming damage for 15 seconds. This spell can use while Stunned, incapacitated, or feared. This spell inflicts Exhaust Soul upon expiration, preventing the application of immunity effects for 30 seconds.

34.name: Toxic Deluge
34.description: Showers your target in a toxic deluge, dealing 90 damage and an additional 45 Poison damage every 6 seconds for 30 seconds.

36.name: Greater Spellshield
36.description: (Merged into Elemental Spellshield in Beta 0.29) A magical shield encircles you, increasing your HP by 75, AC by 20, and Magic Resistance by 20.

38.name: Twisting Shadows
38.description: Conjures twisting shadows, slowing your targets movement speed by 55% and inflicting 15 Corruption Damage every 6 seconds for 60 seconds.
